shared_elements: monolithic anthropomorphic figure carved from an upright block
human face with brow ridge, eyes and nose rendered frontally
blocky, columnar body with head continuous with the block
justification: Both depict a frontal anthropomorphic figure carved as a single upright columnar block, with a schematic face (heavy straight brow, deep-set eyes, broad nose) occupying the upper part and the body continuing as an undifferentiated slab below. The clearest difference is that B carries an elaborate program of incised motifs across the torso \u2014 concentric discs, arcs, a belt-like band and paired vertical elements flanking the head \u2014 whereas A shows only the face with no body iconography visible, so the specific ornamental scheme cannot be matched.
